mapper.select: SELECT s.fqn AS "fqn" , s.symbol_id AS "symbolId" , s.kind AS "kind" , s.package_name AS "packageName" , f.file_id AS "fileId" , f.path AS "path" , f.encoding AS "encoding" , f.language_level AS "languageLevel" FROM analysis_symbol s JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.fqn = #{fqn} ORDER BY s.file_id LIMIT 1
SELECT method_id AS "methodId" , name AS "name" , line_start AS "lineStart" , param_count AS "paramCount" FROM analysis_method WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND NOT is_synthetic

SELECT reference_id AS "referenceId" , from_kind AS "fromKind" , from_id AS "fromId" , ref_kind AS "refKind" , name AS "name" , arg_count AS "argCount" , line_start AS "lineStart" , column_start AS "columnStart" FROM analysis_reference WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
